# 🧠 Quiz Game

**A console quiz game in Java with multiple-choice questions and scoring**

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-ED8B00?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)
![Console app](https://img.shields.io/badge/Console%20app-4b5563?style=flat-square&logo=gnometerminal&logoColor=white)

</div>

## 🎬 Demo

https://github.com/mayankksingh5/Quiz-Game/assets/87350832/2288043e-9569-4b97-a22f-bc03c918e990

## ✨ Features

- ❓ Multiple-choice questions shown one by one
- ✅ Instant feedback, with the correct answer when you get it wrong
- 🏆 Final score at the end of the quiz
- 🧩 Easy to extend: add a new `Question` to include more questions

## 🧱 Design

| Class | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `Question` | Holds the question text, choices and the correct answer |
| `QuizGame` | Runs the quiz, reads input, checks answers and keeps the score |

## 🚀 Run locally

Requires **Java 9+**.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mayankksingh5/Quiz-Game.git
cd Quiz-Game
javac QuizGame.java
java QuizGame
```
